batch_identity.sam3_reuse: one shared lane, never restarted mid-batch

notes: All durations are host wall time; nested spans are reported as sum_ms and union_ms.
llm.response spans come from non-streaming requests, so server-side prefill and hidden thinking are not separable from the client; only the request wall time and token counters are measured.
SAM3 spans carry no episode key (one shared lane), so they are attributed by the episode execution window.
